# FG-REPO-0015

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_move_breaking_a_subtree_rule_is_transfer_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この場所へは移動できません。移動先と名前を確認してください。
- en: This cannot be moved there. Check the destination and the name.
- id: Tidak dapat dipindahkan ke sana. Periksa tujuan dan namanya.

## 原因 (cause)

A namespace move (a project or group transfer or rename, or a user rename; forge_db::projects::move_decided, groups::move_decided, users::rename_decided, step D5 MR2, ADR-0015 Amendment D5) broke a rule of the subtree move before anything was written: the moved namespace has more than 1000 namespaces in its subtree, the new parent is of a kind it may not go under (a project only under a group or a personal namespace, a group only under a group or at the top level, a user only at the top level), the move would change nothing, the new parent is a personal namespace whose owner is a bot or not active (that owner would inherit Owner), the new parent is the moved namespace or one of its descendants, the subtree would end deeper than 20 levels, or a path of the subtree would be longer than 255 characters. Collisions with an existing path or a tombstone are FG-REPO-0009; the segment's own rules FG-REPO-0007 / 0008.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (subtree_too_large with `limit`, target_kind, same_location, parent_owner_bot, parent_owner_inactive, cycle, too_deep with `len` = the deepest new depth, path_too_long with `len` = the longest new path in characters) and the route's ids; paths and names are not logged. The subtree can be inspected with a privileged recursive query on forge.namespaces from the moved namespace's id (parent_id links, depth, full_path).

## 対処 (fix)

Choose another destination or a shorter name; move a large group in parts (move subgroups first); to place a project under a disabled user's namespace, re-enable the user first.
